title: Every example score exports to a set that passes the set checker
description:
As the owner, I want every example score to export to a set that passes the set checker, so that a regression in any mapping shows up before a release.

```gherkin
Feature: Every example exports
  Scenario: The examples export cleanly
    Given the sample library is fetched
    When I export every score in "examples/" as a DAW set
    Then every export succeeds
    And every set passes the set checker
    And every sample each set refers to is in its folder

  Scenario: Samples not fetched
    Given the sample library is not fetched
    When I run the examples export check
    Then it fails and says to run "apricity sources fetch --all"
    And it does not report success
```
